assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Wastewater Collection/Disposal
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Wastewater must be collected and disposed of in the sanitary sewer. It must not be drained on the ground or into storm drains.
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Have direct connection to sanitary sewer Have an adequately sized holding tank with a disposal service Container or bucket used, will dispose into a toilet or mop sink Other
